nom: Clinique All About Clean Liquid Facial Soap Cleanser - Mild

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser controls oil and grime effectively without over-drying; one, though, says the oily-specific liquid formula doesn't get her as squeaky-clean as the discontinued bar soap did, and another found this version left her skin feeling greasy.
segments.dry: The overwhelming majority of reviewers with dry skin report it cleans thoroughly without stripping or tightness, several calling it life-changing for chronic dryness; one 72-year-old with rosacea who relied on the discontinued bar soap, however, found the liquid version drying and painful on her inflamed skin.
segments.sensitive: The overwhelming majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with dermatitis or rosacea, report it cleanses gently without irritation, dryness, or tightness; two exceptions say the liquid formula either could not be tolerated on inflamed, rosacea-affected skin or left a filmy residue that itched.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, whose oiliness and dryness shift by season or by area of the face, report the cleanser keeps their skin balanced year-round.
segments.mature: One reviewer says it works well as part of her routine for aging skin, while another, 72 years old and managing rosacea, found the liquid formula too drying and painful compared to the discontinued bar soap she used to rely on.

concerns.dehydration: An overwhelming number of reviewers, including many with dry or sensitive skin, report the cleanser does not dry out or tighten their skin and even leaves it feeling hydrated; the exception is a 72-year-old reviewer with rosacea, who found this liquid version drying and painful on her already inflamed skin.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with acne-prone or hormonal breakouts, report fewer blemishes, smaller pores, and no new blackheads with regular use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers managing oiliness say it cuts oil and grime effectively without over-drying; two dissent, one saying the oily-specific formula doesn't get her as squeaky-clean as the old bar soap and another finding it left her skin feeling greasy.
concerns.redness: One reviewer cites research linking a preservative in the formula (MCI/MI) to allergen reactions including redness, swelling, and hives, though she is citing outside research rather than her own reaction.
concerns.aging: One reviewer says it works well as part of her routine for aging skin.

aspects.libelle: New lid or pump packaging disliked
Bottle lasts many months, good value
Preservative flagged as a safety concern

extraits.titre: Very poor replacement for the extra mild facial soap bar
extraits.texte: I am very disappointed that Clinique discontinued the extra mild facial soap bar. And there are several reasons why I find the liquid facial soap an unsatisfactory substitute for the bar soap. But the primary reason is the deeply concerning use deeply concerning use of Methylchloroisothiazolinone and Methylisothiazolinone (aka MCI/MI). I strongly agree with another reviewer about the toxicity of these chemicals. The mixture of these two is chiefly used as a preservative in this product -- not as a benefit to the skin of the user. Although used in cosmetic applications (soap, shampoo, etc) it is also used for industrial applications and can be found in paints, moist toilet paper, metalworking fluids. It is proven in multiple studies here (including the NIH) and abroad to be a high allergen, with common symptoms of redness, swelling, hives, itching, and flaky skin. This combination is banned in Europe and several other countries. I have used Clinique products -- especially the bar soap, starting with type 3, then 2, then 1 -- for over 45 years. You have lost a customer for facial cleaning bars -- unless you bring back an extra mild facial soap bar.

I had my rosacea cleared up. Then I ran out of my extra gentle bar soap which was the only thing my face could tolerate. So in desperation I ordered this and I'm sorry but my skin can't tolerate this soap. I also tried the redness solution cleanser. Much to my unhappiness the liquid facial soap was drying and made my inflamed areas hurt. The redness solutions was not painful but my skin remained broken out. It's so embarrassing to be 72 years old suffering from broken out skin. Never any problems before my 60's. I would like to impress on Clinique how some of us relied on the Extra Mild Facial Bar Soap. Why? We need it. Seriously. Is it now being sold under another name? I need this soap. Something they put in liquid soaps people with Sensitive skin absolutely cannot tolerate. Please bring back the bar.

I've always had very dry super sensitive skin, prone to breakouts. I'm now in my mid 30s and I have been using tretinoin for acne and wrinkles. It is helping tremendously, but is very drying to my already dry skin. This face wash (in extra mild for very dry to dry skin) has literally changed my life. I have been using it morning and night for the past 6 months, and my skin has never felt more hydrated. The soap is so creamy, it feels like you are washing with moisturizer. If you struggle with dry, flaking skin this face wash is a must!

extraits.titre: Great for my acne prone skin
extraits.texte: This cleanser works great, I noticed a difference in my skin after the first wash. I struggle with hormonal acne and have always had large pores and kinda dull looking skin. Even after the first wash with this cleanser, my pores were noticeably smaller and my skin glowed. Very impressed!
My go to for cleansers. My face is somehow oily and dry in different places and this soap has been able to clean and moisturize my face without causing even a little bit of irritation!

extraits.titre: Bring back the oily skin bar soap
extraits.texte: I had been using the bar soap for oily skin for years and it did a great job of removing all oil, dirt and leftover makeup from my skin. Clinique is no longer selling that product and the liquid face soap for "oily skin" is just not the same. Doesn't leave that squeaky clean feeling that the other soap did and I'm highly disappointed in the results after using for over a month. If you have very oily skin like I do, this product just doesn't cut it. Not to mention this product is at a much higher price point than the bar soap was. Will not be repurchasing this product. Clinique please bring back the bar soap or I'll be taking my business elsewhere.

I've tried numerous facial cleansers, but they either leave my already dry skin dry or make it too oily, leading to breakouts. However, this cleanser is the best. My skin is silky, supple, and well-hydrated without being oily. I haven't had any breakouts or blackheads. It's perfect for my super-sensitive skin.
